Tiki bears a casual atmosphere and a striking resemblance to a tropical rain forest. Tiki Boat is a double deck party boat from bow to stern, and can accommodate 75 - 100 guests comfortably for a private function. On the lower deck, there are facilities for a DJ or small band, a dance area, tables and chairs, which can be arranged for dining. blurb: TikiBoat offers custom cruises and charters on a party boat in Newport Beach Harbor. The boat can accommodate up to 125 passengers and is available for private, casual, and business functions. Options include live DJs, catering, and a bar; guests may also bring their own food.
